summary: This clinical trial compares a stomach-shrinking procedure called Endoscopic Radial Compression Gastroplasty to an intensive lifestyle program. The goal is to see how well these options manage weight regain after stopping weight-loss medications. The study is sponsored by the Affiliated Hospital to Academy of Military Medical Sciences and is not yet recruiting. A total of 60 participants are expected to take part.
